g.text: BankDash Investments Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 5 key interactive investment valuation charts, stock watchlists & modal flows
Metrics Float & Live Percentage Ticker
3 high-impact cards with icon pulse, valuation tickers, and rate-of-return color shift
TRIGGER: Page load / Hovering metric card
Gradient Spline Area Shimmer & Crosshair
Smooth curved path draw animation with gradient fill shimmer & data coordinate tooltip
TRIGGER: Chart render / Moving crosshair over curve
Multi-Point Line Draw & Peak Value Beacon
Vector line morphs dynamically with pulsating high-point beacon and milestone dots
TRIGGER: Page view / Hovering milestone dots
Stock Card Glide + Live Buy/Sell Modal Flow
Interactive stock entries (Apple, Google, Tesla, PlayStation) with return rate pills & modal
TRIGGER: Hovering stock row / Clicking portfolio item
Market Price Tickers & Trend Indicator Flash
Table rows with green/red trend badges, return percentage glow, and live market updates
TRIGGER: Hovering table row / Live tick update
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Metrics: Live Tickers
Spline: Gradient Shimmer
Line: Peak Radar Beacon
Stocks: Buy/Sell Modal
Watchlist: Trend Flash
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
